title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 0.1 Test 12
summary: Test 12 is an unsigned build of the portable green Mouse Without Borders fork. It expands the modeless Mini Log into a resizable Diagnostic Log with relevant environment, configuration, connection, and recent-event information while continuing to redact the security key.
changes: Fixes the Apply path so a typed security key updates both the running connection and MouseWithoutBorders.prefs.json.
Forces an edited key to finish saving before sockets reconnect, preventing an immediate restart from restoring the old key.
Treats uppercase and lowercase as distinct in manually entered keys, matching the encryption behavior.
Opens Mini Log in an About-sized window with scrollable, selectable text and an explicit Copy all button.
Leaves the clipboard unchanged when Mini Log is merely opened and continues redacting the shared key as a checksum.
Replaces Test 10's modal Mini Log dialog with a modeless viewer that does not disable the Settings window.
Keeps Settings usable while Mini Log remains open; connection and tray behavior are unchanged.
Refreshes and focuses the existing Mini Log viewer on repeated clicks instead of stacking modal windows.
Makes the Diagnostic Log window freely resizable and maximizable.
Removes the ineffective modeless Close button; the normal title-bar X closes the viewer.
Adds version, run mode, EXE and preferences paths, Windows/.NET/architecture, process details, key length/checksum, and the latest bounded portion of the real program log.
Caps the recent-event section at 96 KiB so opening the viewer stays quick, and warns before sharing because names, IPs, and local paths can appear.
Defaults Wrap mouse to off in newly created preference files without changing existing users' saved value.
Documents the key-application repair and revised diagnostic behavior throughout the project.
testing: On each computer, enter the same replacement key in Settings, click Apply, close Settings, reopen it, and confirm the replacement key remains.
Restart both copies and confirm MouseWithoutBorders.prefs.json and the Settings box still contain the replacement key.
Confirm the two computers connect without a key-mismatch warning and repeat with a key whose letter case differs to verify case-sensitive handling.
Copy some recognizable text, open Mini Log, and confirm the existing clipboard remains unchanged until Copy all is pressed.
Confirm Mini Log text is visible, scrollable, selectable, and copyable with both Ctrl+C and Copy all.
Leave Mini Log open and confirm Settings, the tray menu, and normal mouse/keyboard sharing remain responsive.
Click Mini Log repeatedly and confirm the existing viewer refreshes and comes forward without opening duplicate windows.
Resize and maximize the Diagnostic Log, then close it with the title-bar X and reopen it.
Confirm the report contains environment, configuration, connection, and recent-event sections but never displays the actual security key.
Create a brand-new portable preferences file and confirm Wrap mouse is off; separately confirm an existing saved Wrap mouse choice is preserved.
Retest mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, firewall prompting, and sleep/wake behavior with this same Test 12 EXE on both computers.
